title: Designing Event-Driven Serverless Architecture
description: Design a complete event-driven workflow using Azure Functions, Service Bus, and Logic Apps.

data.text: Design an order processing system: when a customer places an order, validate inventory, process payment, send confirmation email, and update analytics. Each step must be decoupled and retryable.
Use **Azure Service Bus** for reliable message queuing between services. Use **Azure Functions** for processing steps. Use **Logic Apps** for orchestrating the workflow and sending emails.

data.title: Azure Function - Service Bus Trigger

data.text: This architecture is **loosely coupled** and **resilient**. Service Bus ensures no messages are lost. Functions provide scalable processing. Logic Apps handle orchestration without code.
